description: When the journal's story may close a chapter the narrator has lived past by looking back on it. A look back is said only by a narrator whose recorded temperament carries the trait named here; the trait's meaning in the personality catalogue is why it fits. Feelings come from the records and the traits, never from chance (owner, via CTO 4:30 p.m. Oct 8).
